scientific_requirements: Score only task-scoped paper scientific findings, never research process, tool counts, cost, formatting or failure explanations. Every item is binary: full assigned points for a supported match, otherwise zero for an incorrect or absent result. Identify molecules, connectivity, atom inventory, charge/spin, observable, units, reference state and conditions before comparing. Require genuine linked managed computations and native artifacts; supplied observations, copied paper values and normal termination alone are insufficient. Validate minima and transition states as required by the unchanged public task. Alternative software, methods and candidate labels are permitted when the physical result is comparable. No historical verification trajectory, fixed hypothesis count or new computation outside the public scope is required. Use the authored numerical targets and tolerances; the Judge must not adjust them. A number in source context without a tolerance does not create a new numerical gate. Do not invent tolerances or treat sign/order alone as a quantitative magnitude match. Unresolved essential reference comparability requires needs_review. Assess independent items separately; a failed numerical item does not automatically erase an independently supported qualitative conclusion. Conclusion points require an explicit supported final inference or selection, not merely computing or listing a matching candidate. Qualitative findings carry separate points for actual computed topology, trends or bounded scientific inferences. Numerical failure alone does not invalidate independently supported qualitative findings; correct words without genuine supporting calculations do not pass. Tolerances are provisional benchmark acceptance policies approved on 2026-10-17, not author error bars or statistical confidence intervals. Expert review may revise a future version, but absence of that later review does not block this version.
